repos.name: YizhiSong/FriesTrader
repos.description: A fully automated AI trading agent that trades real Robinhood orders via its Agentic Trading MCP under mechanical, auditable risk rules the model cannot override. Once set up, it is able to run on its own schedule, screening and trading stocks under a narrow, explicit gate. Cheap to run — Claude Pro only, no metered API spend. Not financial advice.
repos.one_liner: A fully automated AI trading agent that executes real Robinhood orders using an Agentic Trading MCP with hard-coded, immutable risk constraints.
bullets: Built in Python using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to bridge LLM reasoning with financial execution.
Implements a 'hard-coded' risk management layer that operates independently of the AI model's decision-making.
Designed for auditable, automated trading workflows on the Robinhood platform.
Focuses on the intersection of agentic autonomy and strict financial safety protocols.

repos.name: kvcache-ai/AgentENV
repos.description: AgentENV (AENV) is a distributed platform for running agent environments at scale.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance, distributed platform built in Rust for scaling agent environments.
bullets: Core architecture written in Rust, emphasizing memory safety and high-concurrency execution.
Provides a distributed infrastructure layer to manage and scale multiple agent environments simultaneously.
Enables complex simulation and testing of agent behaviors in isolated, reproducible environments.
Ideal for enterprise-scale AI deployments requiring robust orchestration and environment management.

repos.name: FareedKhan-dev/kimi-k3-in-c
repos.description: A 2.78-trillion-parameter Kimi K3 running inference on a single CPU in 8.24 GB of RAM. Portable C99: no BLAS, no framework, no GPU.
repos.one_liner: A portable C99 implementation for running a 2.78-trillion-parameter model on a single CPU with minimal memory overhead.
bullets: Zero-dependency C99 codebase requiring no external BLAS, frameworks, or GPU acceleration.
Achieves extreme efficiency by running massive parameter models in just 8.24 GB of RAM.
Demonstrates a breakthrough in local inference optimization for resource-constrained hardware.
Useful for developers looking to deploy large-scale intelligence on edge devices or standard server CPUs.
